components.name: Primary Text Link

components.html: Google Scholar
components.css: .ds-link-primary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; color: #18181b; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; position: relative; padding-bottom: 2px; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1); } .ds-link-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background-color: #18181b; transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: bottom left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1); } .ds-link-primary:hover { color: #6b6687; } .ds-link-primary:hover::after { transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: bottom right; } .ds-link-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: #9ca3af; transition: color 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-link-primary:hover svg { color: #6b6687; transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

narrative.overview:
The design system for bilalabbasi.com unites two sovereign worlds under a single, disciplined visual philosophy inspired by Dieter Rams ("less, but better"). On one side lies the Scholar's Monograph: an austere, monochromatic research portfolio tailored for academic peers, scientific collaborators, and systems engineers. On the other lies the Spice Folio: an intimate, aromatic culinary archive celebrating diaspora recipes, Urdu language heritage, and mother's cooking.

The interface treats digital space like high-grade tactile paper. Dark charcoal typography rests upon a calm canvas (#ffffff and #fafaf9), paired with hand-drawn ink sketches that merge into the page texture via mix-blend-mode: multiply. Visual noise is ruthlessly pruned: there are no commercial blog popups, cookie banners, intrusive gradients, or decorative drop-shadows.

Interaction is unhurried and tactile. Links reveal themselves through sliding hairline rules; recipe decks paginate with vertical scroll snapping; and Urdu typography sits alongside English with optical balance and dignity.
keyCharacteristics: Sovereign Dual Spaces: Absolute aesthetic separation between the grayscale research profile and the warm, high-chroma culinary archive.
Architectural Stability: Fixed navigation coordinates (60px height, 160px vertical baseline) eliminating layout jump across all page transitions.
Paper & Ink Tactility: Expressive sketchwork blending directly into the warm background canvas.
Dieter Rams Restraint: Functional clarity where every line, rule, and margin earns its presence.

rules.name: The Sovereign Palette Rule
rules.body: The professional portfolio is strictly monochromatic grayscale; terracotta, amber, and denim accents must never bleed into the /professional/ space.

rules.name: The Ink Rarity Rule
rules.body: High-chroma colors (#721817, #fa9f42, #2b4162) are reserved exclusively for titles, links, badges, and interactive feedback—never for long-form body text.

rules.name: The Dynamic Theme Rule
rules.body: Kitchen and recipe accent colors must be defined in KITCHEN_CONFIG.theme within config.js and injected as CSS variables, never hardcoded into stylesheet roots.

rules.name: The Serif-Sans Partition Rule
rules.body: Headings and expressive titles belong strictly to Lora serif; all functional labels, metadata, navigation, and body copy belong strictly to Inter sans.

rules.name: The Justified Monograph Rule
rules.body: Desktop biographical text uses justified alignment (text-align: justify) with a constrained reading measure (max-width: 580px) to mirror a printed monograph column.

rules.name: The Bilingual Dignity Rule
rules.body: Urdu typography (اردو) is set inline with identical dignity and optical size matching its English counterpart, never rendered as an undersized subscript.

rules.name: The 160px Baseline Lock
rules.body: The top coordinate of the primary title, subtitle, and biography text blocks must start at exactly top: 160px across all pages (40px wrapper padding + 60px fixed navbar height + 60px content margin-top). Container-level vertical centering or auto margins are strictly forbidden.

rules.name: The Paper Gutter Rule
rules.body: scrollbar-gutter: stable is declared globally on html to preserve horizontal layout stability when navigating between non-scrollable and scrollable pages.

rules.name: The Snap Offset Rule
rules.body: All scroll-snapped full-screen sections must declare scroll-margin-top: 100px to offset the navbar's layout footprint and prevent initial page jump on load.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Containers, panels, and buttons must be completely flat at rest. Drop-shadows are strictly dynamic reactions to hover or focus states.

rules.name: The Border Contrast Rule
rules.body: Structural containment uses 1px solid hairline borders (#e5e7eb); internal recipe sub-sections use 1px dashed borders to evoke perforated notebook paper.

dos: Do maintain the exact 60px navbar height and 160px title top coordinate across all pages to guarantee visual stability.
Do keep the professional portfolio strictly monochromatic grayscale (#18181b, #4b5563, #9ca3af).
Do centralize all kitchen theme color modifications in KITCHEN_CONFIG.theme within config.js.
Do apply mix-blend-mode: multiply on sketch illustrations so the illustration paper seamlessly melts into the page background.
Do declare scrollbar-gutter: stable globally to prevent horizontal baseline jumping between scrollable and non-scrollable pages.
Do ensure all recipe data structures and scripts remain zero-dependency and fully operational on file:/// local URLs.
donts: Don't bleed warm terracotta, amber, or denim colors into the professional profile page.
Don't use margin-top: auto or container vertical centering (align-items: center) on .main-content.
Don't introduce external UI framework bundles, icon font packages, or build dependencies.
Don't apply heavy drop-shadows, glossy gradients, or commercial blog widgets.
Don't add query-string cache buster parameters (e.g. ?v=2) to script or stylesheet tags that break local file:/// filesystem resolution.
